steps: 1. Recover without restarting discovery. In the implementation role, update P08/progress.md with the current files, these verified findings, the reviewed plan reference and exact unfinished work. Preserve prior source bytes, accepted phases, frozen benchmark files and all protected supervisor files. Limit edits to the P08 engine, checker, tests, declared deliverables and necessary versioned research records.

2. Refresh the evidence contract before repairs. Question: does inspected applicable authority support the bounded lifecycle and a matched cross-standard comparison? Baselines: independently derived present values/cash flows and the existing dossier as an arithmetic regression only. Acceptance requires source applicability, complete operation semantics, reproducible stored cases and a supported comparator. Missing authority vetoes affected claims; incorrect calculations, admission or artifact consistency veto engineering acceptance. Record provenance, justification, failure mode, early diagnostic and status for each material assumption. Reserve the final 120 seconds for checks and reporting.

3. Complete targeted authority preparation. Reinspect the existing AASB 132/9/7 anchors supporting classification, residual equity, initial measurement, effective interest, settlement and selected notes. Verify each edition's own reporting-period and transition limits. Make bounded attempts through legitimate official FASB publication routes for ASU 2020-06 and applicable ASC 470/815 provisions, and Ministry of Finance routes for ASBE 22/37. Use EUR-Lex's official document formats as a secondary comparator route where accessible. Limit each request to 30 seconds and each authority family to two distinct official routes; do not repeatedly poll failed routes. Preserve successful bytes, hashes, dates and exact anchors, or source-specific failure metadata. An empty HTTP response is unavailable text. Stop inaccessible routes once and continue independent repairs.

4. Repair lifecycle authority dependencies. Require the initial fair-value claim and link it to issuance. Audit whether residual-equity and amortised-cost claims likewise need explicit operation dependencies instead of merely appearing in the register. Validate nonempty anchors and applicable source records for every required operation claim. Keep unknown eligibility and unsupported terms rejected before state mutation. Add focused tests removing or invalidating each required dependency, with unchanged-state checks where an event fails.

5. Implement or precisely specify the supported comparator only after inspecting its authority. Hold contract cash flows, dates, currency relationship, conversion rights, funding, market assumptions and relevant issuer characteristics fixed; vary the reporting regime and supported treatment. For a US comparator, verify adoption timing, entity category, embedded-feature exceptions and conversion/derecognition rules before computing any single-liability treatment. Produce exact initial measurement, both annual periods and both maturity outcomes, explaining each difference or agreement with paragraph anchors. If sources remain unavailable, retain null results and explicit missing provisions; criterion 3 remains incomplete.

6. Strengthen deliverable validation. Reconstruct every Contract from stored facts, execute run_case with its recorded funding and settlement, and compare initial values, complete journals, final state and notes using canonical exact serialization. Independently recompute PV, interest and cash reconciliation. Compare embedded authority/claim records with the referenced register in full, verify source hashes and resolve every operation, posting and note link. Recompute comparison hashes from canonical common economic facts and validate supported rows against their treatment calculations. Replace hard-coded unresolved-row expectations with explicit supported/unresolved schemas and separate engineering-conformance and four-criterion acceptance statuses.

7. Add meaningful regression tests in tests/test_accounting_p08.py. Require detection of altered case numbers, journal postings, note movements, claim text, missing claims, stale source hashes, fabricated common hashes and altered comparator economics. Retain existing parameterized lifecycle, chronology, funding and atomicity tests. Exercise all supported comparator outcomes and unresolved-source behavior separately. A fully source-supported comparison must be necessary for marking criterion 3 complete.

8. Regenerate authority-and-methods.json and result.md from checked executions. Retain the six specific method queues and the ACTUS defer decision; inspect technical sections and official code before adopting any additional research mechanism. Include operation preconditions, recognition, measurement, state/posting effects, note links, exact cases, criterion-by-criterion status and a decision table. Record actual commands, environment, wall time, provenance observed without Git initialization, input hashes, plan/result paths and every changed file. Preserve source access history; do not overwrite failed attempts with later successes.

9. Run python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_accounting_p08.py' -v and python3 -B scripts/check_accounting_p08.py --check with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=-1. Embed bounded structured verification in the declared deliverables rather than creating undeclared supervisor files. Verify required files and protected-file hashes against the current supervisor pre-edit inventory. Report remaining authority dependencies and failed criteria honestly, then submit for independent review.
